description: The Pterosaur Racing Referee acting as a judge at the finish line for a tie.
character_anchor: Adult male paleontologist, Latino ethnicity, short brown hair, wearing signature thin-rimmed BLACK AVIATOR glasses. He wears a tan safari pith helmet and a black-and-white vertical striped referee jersey over a khaki safari vest.
action: He is leaning forward with a look of relief, holding  two identical small silver trophies, one in each hand, indicating a draw.
setting: The finish line of a prehistoric track.
visual_identity: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style; dynamic posing and cinematic appeal.
